entities.name: Stalinist Era & the Forest Brothers
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The second Soviet occupation, the massive March 1949 deportation of over 42,000 Latvians, forced collectivisation, and the Forest Brothers (meža brāļi) partisan resistance. The destruction of Latvian cultural and economic independence.
